skus.name: Roborock S-Series Pro — LiDAR Robot Vacuum + Auto-Mop Dock
skus.description_short: Lidar-mapping vacuum + auto-lifting mop with self-empty + self-wash dock. The set-and-forget machine for pet households.
skus.description_long: S-Series Pro is engineered for the household that's tried two cheap robots and given up. 10,000 Pa suction lifts embedded pet hair on first pass; a heated wash dock cleans and dries the mop pad after every run; lidar SLAM creates a 3-floor map with no-go zones; and the auto-empty bin holds 7 weeks of dust before you even think about it.
key_features: 10,000 Pa HyperForce suction (lifts embedded pet hair)
Lidar SLAM mapping — 3-floor support, no-go zones
Auto-lifting mop pads — 10mm clearance over carpet
Self-empty + self-wash + heated dry dock (7 weeks bin capacity)
Reactive 3D obstacle avoidance — recognizes 30+ object types
skus.usp: Solves pain_001 (gets stuck), pain_002 (pet hair tangles) and pain_003 (mop streaks) in one box. Anchor competitor comp_002 (Roborock S8 MaxV) at $1,599 — we ship same lidar tier at $1,199.

tech_explainers.title: PreciSense lidar SLAM, in plain language
tech_explainers.body_md: A spinning laser on top of the puck shoots ~5,000 distance measurements per second. Software stitches those into a centimeter-resolution map and tracks where the robot is on that map in real time. Two practical wins: it works in pitch dark (cameras don't), and the map doesn't drift across weeks of runs (gyro nav does). Result: the robot follows the same efficient path every cycle, instead of re-running spots it already cleaned.

tech_explainers.title: Why the V-shape brush doesn't wrap pet hair
tech_explainers.body_md: A bristle roller catches hair on the bristle root, then friction wraps the whole roller. The V-shape silicone fins do the opposite — hair slides along the fin toward the centerline and into the suction port. Twelve weeks with a golden retriever: zero untanglings. (We made a video.)

tech_explainers.title: Auto-mop dock — what it actually does between cycles
tech_explainers.body_md: After every cycle the robot returns to the dock. The dock pumps clean water through the mop pads, scrubs them against ridged plates, vacuums the dirty water into a separate tank, and finishes with a 60-minute hot-air dry. Net effect: mop pads stay clean enough to use for 6 months without replacement, and the dock never smells like a wet rag.

tech_explainers.title: Reactive 3D obstacle avoidance, honestly
tech_explainers.body_md: A structured-light projector + camera maps small objects in real time. The model recognizes 30+ classes — cables, socks, phone chargers, pet waste, slippers, kid's toys, weighing scales. It routes around them instead of pushing them. It's not perfect (it'll occasionally miss a black cable on a black floor), but the failure mode is 'stop and ask in the app,' not 'eat the cable.'

setup_steps.title: Unbox and place the dock
setup_steps.instruction: Place the dock against a wall with at least 0.5m clear on each side and 1.5m in front. Plug it in. The status light pulses white when ready.

setup_steps.title: Sit the robot on the dock
setup_steps.instruction: Lift the robot onto the dock. The metal contacts on the back of the robot align with the dock pins. The robot beeps once and the dock light turns solid white when seated.

setup_steps.title: Install the Roborock app
setup_steps.instruction: Download 'Roborock' from the App Store or Google Play. Create an account or sign in. Tap '+' to add a new device. Select S-Series Pro from the list.

setup_steps.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
setup_steps.instruction: The app asks for your home Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz only — the robot does not connect to 5 GHz). Enter the password. The robot beeps three times when connected. This step takes ~2 minutes.

setup_steps.title: Run the first mapping cycle
setup_steps.instruction: In the app, tap 'Map your home.' The robot leaves the dock and runs a single mapping pass — no suction, no mop, just lidar. For a 1,200 sq ft home this takes 25–35 minutes. Stay out of its way; you'll get a clean map.

setup_steps.title: Edit the map (optional)
setup_steps.instruction: When mapping finishes, the app shows the map. Drag walls to split rooms, name them, and mark no-go zones (under-bed, in front of pet bowls, etc.). Saved maps persist forever — you only do this once.

setup_steps.title: Schedule your first real clean
setup_steps.instruction: Set a daily schedule (we recommend 9 a.m. weekdays — most people are out). Pick rooms, suction power, and whether to mop. Tap 'Save.' You're done.

skus.name: Roborock E-Series Essential — Smart Robot Vacuum
skus.description_short: Lidar-grade mapping at the half-price tier. Auto-empty optional. Perfect first robot.
skus.description_long: E-Series Essential brings real lidar mapping (not bump-nav) under $500. Choose with or without the auto-empty dock add-on. Same anti-tangle brush as the Pro — half the dock, all the cleaning.
key_features: Lidar SLAM mapping (real, not random walk)
skus.usp: Best lidar-tier price-point in the market — directly attacks comp_003 (Eufy 11S, no lidar at this price) and comp_005 (Shark Matrix, $399 without lidar).

tech_explainers.title: Real lidar — not 'lidar-assist'
tech_explainers.body_md: Some sub-$500 robots claim 'lidar-assist' but actually run gyro navigation with a single-point lidar dot for assist. The E-Series uses the same spinning lidar puck as our flagship — slightly cheaper module, same SLAM math. The map doesn't drift, doesn't need a re-train each week, and works in the dark.

tech_explainers.title: Why we kept the anti-tangle brush at this price
tech_explainers.body_md: The brush is the most-asked-about part on PDP. Cheaper bristle rollers wrap pet hair and need weekly cleaning. We carried the V-shape silicone design from the Pro because it's cheap to manufacture once tooled, and it's the single biggest day-to-day quality-of-life difference for pet households.

tech_explainers.title: What the optional dock add-on does
tech_explainers.body_md: The base bot ships without an auto-empty dock. The $129 add-on slides into the same charging spot and gives you ~45 days of bin capacity instead of 4–5 days. Most apartment owners skip it. Most pet households add it within 60 days.

setup_steps.title: Charge the robot for 90 minutes
setup_steps.instruction: Plug in the included charging contact. The robot ships at ~30% — give it a full charge before the first mapping run. The light goes solid white when full.

setup_steps.title: Install the Roborock app and sign in
setup_steps.instruction: Download 'Roborock' from your app store. Create an account. Tap '+', select 'E-Series Essential' from the device list.

setup_steps.title: Connect to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
setup_steps.instruction: Enter your home Wi-Fi credentials. The robot connects only on 2.4 GHz (not 5 GHz). Two beeps = connected.

setup_steps.title: Run the first mapping pass
setup_steps.instruction: Tap 'Map your home.' The robot lidar-scans without cleaning. ~25 minutes for a typical apartment. Don't move it during this pass.

setup_steps.title: Schedule your first clean
setup_steps.instruction: Pick a daily time, choose rooms, and tap save. We recommend running it once a day in pet households, twice a week otherwise.

key_features: 1 main brush + 4 side brushes + 4 HEPA filters + 8 mop pads
Subscribe & save: 20% off + auto-ship every 6 months
skus.usp: Solves pain_005 (recurring consumable surprise) by bundling 6 months at predictable cost. Kills the 'oh I need a new filter' Amazon search loop.

tech_explainers.title: Why we ship a 6-month bundle (not individual parts)
tech_explainers.body_md: Owners forget the brush before they forget the filter, and the filter before they forget the mop pads. We grouped them in one kit on the same 6-month cadence so 'replenish' is one decision, not five Amazon searches. Subscribe and we ship before you notice; cancel any time.

tech_explainers.title: How long parts actually last (in a pet household)
tech_explainers.body_md: The pessimistic version: brush 4–5 months, filter 6–8 weeks, mop pad 3 months. The kit gives you headroom on all three for a 6-month cycle in a 2-pet, 1,200 sq ft home. If you don't have pets, the kit lasts 9–12 months — many subscribers skip every other shipment.
